setup.title: Welcome to ekPanel
setup.subtitle: Create the administrator account. You only do this once.
setup.token_hint: The installer printed it. You can also find it in /var/lib/ekpanel/setup-token on the server.

account.name: Your name
account.password_hint: At least 10 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Manage your servers, sites and apps.
login.code_subtitle: One more step to keep your account safe.
login.code_help: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code for ekPanel.

security.intro: Protect your account and control where you are signed in.

twofa.title: Two-factor authentication
twofa.body: Signing in will need a code from your phone as well as your password.
twofa.qr_alt: QR code for your authenticator app
twofa.step_scan: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app such as Google Authenticator, Aegis or 1Password.
twofa.step_code: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
twofa.manual: Can't scan? Type this key into the app instead:
twofa.disable_password: Enter your password to turn it off

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.body: If you signed in on a computer you no longer use, sign out everywhere else. This device stays signed in.
sessions.revoked: All other devices are signed out.

password.title: Password
password.body: Changing it signs you out on every other device.

security.not_while_acting: These settings belong to the customer. Go back to your own account to change yours.

servers.intro: Every server runs a small agent that connects it to this panel.
servers.name: Server name
servers.name_hint: Something you will recognise, like "Singapore web 1".

empty.title: Connect your first server
empty.body: Add a Linux server (Ubuntu or Debian). You run one command on it, and it shows up here with live statistics.

enroll.title: Connect {{name}}
enroll.intro: Run these commands on the server as root. The agent connects out to this panel, so you do not need to open any port.
enroll.step1: 1. Register the server with this panel
enroll.token_note: The token in the command works once and expires {{when}}. It will not be shown again.
enroll.connected: Connected! The server is sending live statistics.
enroll.waiting: Waiting for the agent to connect…
enroll.port_note: The agent connects to this panel on TCP port {{port}}. If the panel's server has a firewall, allow that port.

pending.title: This server is not connected yet
pending.body: Its agent has not registered. The command shown when you added it may have expired; create a fresh one.

servers.offline_help: The agent is not connected. It was last seen {{when}}. Check that the server is running and that the agent service is started.
servers.history_note: Live shows about the last 20 minutes. Pick a range to see up to 30 days.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: The panel forgets this server and its agent can no longer connect. Nothing on the server itself is deleted.

metrics.history_step_one: Each point is the average of {{count, number}} minute.
metrics.history_step_other: Each point is the average of {{count, number}} minutes.
metrics.no_history: No history for this period yet. It is recorded while the agent is connected.

dashboard.customer_intro: Your websites, databases and apps, and what your package allows.

audit.intro: Every change made in this panel, who made it and from where. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.

errors.network: Could not reach the panel. Check your connection and try again.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on the panel. The error has been logged.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.cross_site: This request was blocked for your safety. Reload the page and try again.
errors.json_required: The request was not in the expected format.
errors.invalid_body: The request was not in the expected format.
errors.body_too_large: That is too large to send.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.invalid_setup_token: That setup token is not correct.
errors.already_set_up: This panel already has an administrator. Sign in instead.
errors.invalid_name: Enter a name of up to 100 characters.
errors.weak_password: Use a password of at least 10 characters.
errors.invalid_credentials: Email or password is not correct.
errors.totp_required: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
errors.invalid_totp: That code is not correct. Codes change every 30 seconds.
errors.unsupported_locale: That language is not available yet.
errors.server_not_found: That server does not exist. It may have been deleted.
errors.invalid_enroll_token: That connection token is wrong, used or expired.
errors.invalid_agent_credentials: The agent's credential is not valid. Connect the server again.
errors.agent_offline: The server's agent is not connected.
errors.agent_timeout: The agent did not answer in time. Try again.
errors.agent_not_allowed: The agent does not allow that action.
errors.agent_unknown_op: The agent is too old for this. Update the agent.
errors.agent_invalid_params: The panel sent the agent something it could not read.
errors.invalid_service: Enter the name of the service in the Compose file that listens on this port.
errors.invalid_range: That time range is not available.
errors.invalid_csr: The agent sent an invalid certificate request.
errors.agent_no_systemd: This server does not run systemd (for example a container), so its services cannot be shown or restarted.
errors.invalid_domain: Enter a domain name such as example.com.
errors.invalid_alias: One of the extra domains is not a valid domain name.
errors.too_many_aliases: A website can have at most 20 extra domains.
errors.invalid_php_version: Choose one of the listed PHP versions.
errors.hostname_taken: Another website already uses this domain.
errors.site_not_found: That website does not exist. It may have been deleted.
errors.invalid_database_name: Use up to 32 lowercase letters, digits and _ , starting with a letter. System names are not allowed.
errors.invalid_database_user: Use up to 32 lowercase letters, digits and _ , starting with a letter. System names are not allowed.
errors.database_name_taken: This server already has a database with that name.
errors.database_user_taken: This server already has a database user with that name.
errors.database_not_found: That database does not exist. It may have been deleted.
errors.file_not_found: That file or folder does not exist (any more).
errors.file_exists: Something with that name already exists here.
errors.file_not_allowed: That is not allowed. Protected folders cannot be moved or deleted.
errors.file_bad_offset: The upload got out of step. Upload the file again.
errors.file_failed: The server could not do that.
errors.invalid_upload: The upload request was not valid.
errors.invalid_ssh_key: One of the SSH keys is not valid. Paste the public key (the .pub file).
errors.too_many_ssh_keys: A site can have at most 20 SSH keys.
errors.wordpress_needs_php: WordPress needs a PHP site. Switch the site to PHP first.
errors.app_installed: An application is already installed on this site.
errors.invalid_wp_admin_user: Use 3–60 letters, digits and . _ @ - for the admin user name.
errors.invalid_wp_title: The title must be up to 100 characters on one line.
errors.invalid_wp_locale: Choose a language from the list.
errors.agent_not_empty: The website folder already has files. Move or delete them first.
errors.invalid_schedule: That schedule is not valid. Use five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week.
errors.invalid_retention: Keep at least one backup, and no more than 365 daily, 520 weekly or 240 monthly.
errors.invalid_backup_kind: Choose this server or S3 storage.
errors.backup_repo_not_found: That backup location does not exist.
errors.invalid_restore_mode: Choose whether to restore into a new folder or replace the current files.
errors.invalid_restore: Choose a website or database to restore.
errors.connect_needs_s3: Only backups kept in S3 storage can be connected again.
errors.agent_wrong_recovery_key: That recovery key does not open the backups at this location.
errors.invalid_firewall_mode: Choose on, off or not managed.
errors.invalid_firewall_rule: Choose to open a port or block an address.
errors.invalid_ports: Enter a port such as 8080, or a range such as 6000-6010.
errors.invalid_source: Enter an IP address, or a range such as 203.0.113.0/24.
errors.firewall_blocks_you: That would block your own address and cut you off from this panel.
errors.too_many_firewall_rules: A server can have up to 200 firewall rules.
errors.invalid_app_name: Use 2–32 lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter.
errors.invalid_app_kind: An app runs either an image or a Compose file.
errors.invalid_image: Enter an image such as nginx:1.27 or ghcr.io/owner/app:latest.
errors.invalid_compose: Paste a Compose file of up to 256 KB.
errors.invalid_port: The port must be between 1 and 65535.
errors.domain_needs_port: A domain needs the port the app listens on.
errors.invalid_env: Each variable is NAME=value on its own line; names use letters, digits and _, and appear once.
errors.invalid_volume: A kept folder is a path inside the container, such as /data.
errors.invalid_limits: Memory must be at least 16 MB and CPUs more than 0.
errors.app_name_taken: This server already has an app with that name.
errors.app_not_ready: The app has not been set up on its server yet.
errors.limit_reached_site: Your package allows no more websites.
errors.limit_reached_database: Your package allows no more databases.
errors.limit_reached_app: Your package allows no more apps.
errors.quota_exceeded: The disk space of the package is used up. Delete files to free some.
errors.server_not_allowed: This package cannot use that server.
errors.php_version_not_allowed: The package does not include this PHP version.
errors.compose_not_allowed: Customers can run Docker images, not Compose files.
errors.image_not_allowed: The package does not include this image.
errors.sftp_not_allowed: The package does not include SFTP.
errors.package_in_use: Move its customers to another package first.
errors.invalid_package: Check the numbers: counts from 0, at least 1 MB of disk, 64 MB of memory and 5% CPU.
errors.email_taken: Another account uses this email address.
errors.customer_has_resources: Delete or move the customer's websites, databases and apps first.
errors.already_impersonating: Go back to your own account first.
errors.not_impersonating: You are signed in as yourself.
errors.invalid_timezone: Choose a time zone such as Asia/Dhaka.
errors.invalid_command: Enter a command of up to 4096 characters.
errors.invalid_timeout: The time limit must be between 10 seconds and 24 hours.
errors.invalid_cron_target: A job belongs to a website or an app.
errors.cron_not_ready: The job has not been set up on its server yet.
errors.limit_reached_cron: Your package allows no more cron jobs.
errors.invalid_chat_id: Enter the chat's numeric ID or its @name.
errors.invalid_bot_token: Enter the token that @BotFather gave, such as 123456:ABC…
errors.invalid_hook_url: Enter the webhook address the service gave you. It must use https.
errors.invalid_hook_key: The signing key needs 16 to 200 characters.
errors.invalid_channel_kind: Choose email, Telegram, Discord, Slack or a webhook.
errors.too_many_channels: You can have up to 20 channels.
errors.channel_failed: The message could not be sent.
errors.invalid_panel_url: Enter the address people use to open the panel, such as https://panel.example.com.
errors.invalid_smtp: Check the mail server's host name, port and security.
errors.confirm_required: Enter your password again to open a terminal.
errors.domain_required: This service is used through its domain; enter one.
errors.template_not_found: That service is not in the catalogue.
errors.git_not_allowed: The package does not include Git apps.
errors.invalid_repo: Enter the repository's https:// address, or its SSH address (git@host:owner/repo.git).
errors.invalid_branch: Enter a branch name, such as main.
errors.invalid_repo_path: The Dockerfile and build folder are paths inside the repository.
errors.port_required: Enter the port the app listens on inside its container.
errors.rollback_not_possible: Only the last five earlier releases can be returned to.
errors.git_app_update: A Git app is updated by deploying it.
errors.invalid_builder: Build with the Dockerfile, with Railpack, or automatically.
errors.preview_domain_required: Enter the domain previews go under, such as preview.example.com.
errors.certificate_required: Upload a certificate to use your own.
errors.invalid_php_extension: Choose an optional extension of a supported PHP version.

not_found.title: Page not found
not_found.body: The page you are looking for does not exist or has moved.

services.title: Services
services.offline: The agent is offline, so service status is not available.

tasks.none: No tasks yet. Actions such as restarting a service show up here.

sites.intro: Each website gets its own Linux account and PHP processes, so one site cannot touch another.

empty.title: Add your first website
empty.body: Point a domain at one of your servers, choose PHP or static, and ekPanel sets up the web server and a free SSL certificate.

sites.none_on_server: No websites on this server yet.
sites.need_server: Connect a server first. Websites are hosted on your servers.
sites.domain_hint: For example example.com. Names in any language and script work.
sites.aliases_hint: One per line. Visitors to these addresses see the same site.

kind.label: Type of site
kind.php_hint: WordPress, Laravel and other PHP applications.
kind.static_hint: HTML, CSS and JavaScript files only. The fastest option.

sites.php_install_note: A version that is not on the server yet is installed automatically. This can take a few minutes the first time.

tls.label: SSL certificate (HTTPS)
tls.auto_hint: Let's Encrypt, renewed automatically. The domain's DNS must point to this server.
tls.internal_hint: For testing, or domains not on the public internet. Browsers show a warning.

sites.applying: Applying your settings on {{server}}. This usually takes a few seconds.
sites.deleting: Deleting this website and its files…
sites.delete_failed: Deleting is not finished yet: {{reason}}. ekPanel keeps trying.
sites.error_title: The server could not apply this website's settings
sites.saved: Saved. The server is applying the changes.

delete.title: Delete {{domain}}?
delete.body: Removes the website, its files and its Linux account from the server.
delete.warning: This permanently deletes everything in /home/{{user}}, including uploaded files. Make a backup first if you need them.

sites.waiting_offline: {{server}} is offline. The settings are applied as soon as its agent reconnects.

redirects.title: Redirects
redirects.intro: Send visitors from one address to another, in the order listed.
redirects.aliases_hint: Visitors of the extra domains go to the same page on the main domain (301).
redirects.keep_path: Keep the rest of the path (/blog/post goes to …/post)
redirects.hint: From is a path such as /old-page, or a prefix such as /blog/* for everything under it. To is a path or a full address.

hotlink.title: Hotlink protection
hotlink.intro: Stop other websites from showing your images and media on their pages, using your bandwidth.
hotlink.extensions_hint: Separated by commas. Requests from pages of other sites get 403; direct visits still work.
hotlink.allowed_hint: One domain per line; *.example.com allows all its subdomains. This site's own domains always may.

php_settings.title: PHP settings
php_settings.intro: php.ini values for this site's PHP {{version}}. Empty fields use the default shown.
php_settings.hint: Applications can still raise these values themselves, except allow_url_fopen.

help.allow_url_fopen: Let PHP open web addresses as files.
help.date_timezone: The time zone date functions use, such as Asia/Dhaka.
help.display_errors: Show errors on pages. Keep it off on live sites.
help.max_execution_time: Seconds a request may run; 0 means no limit.
help.max_input_time: Seconds to receive a request's data; -1 uses the execution time.
help.memory_limit: Memory one request may use, such as 512M.
help.post_max_size: Largest form or upload request, such as 128M.
help.session_gc_maxlifetime: Seconds before an idle session is cleaned up.

certificate.title: Own SSL certificate
certificate.intro: Sites get a free certificate automatically. Upload one only if you need a certificate you bought.
certificate.intro_custom: This site uses a certificate you uploaded. Remove it to go back to a free one.
certificate.uncovered: The certificate does not cover {{names}}; those addresses will show a warning.
certificate.hint: PEM files. The key is encrypted on the panel and stored only on the server. You are notified two weeks before the certificate expires.

php_ext.title: PHP extensions
php_ext.intro: Extensions of PHP {{version}} on this server, for every site using it. Locked ones are always installed.
php_ext.none: No PHP version is installed yet; one is installed with the first PHP site.

databases.intro: MariaDB and PostgreSQL databases for your websites and apps. Each has its own account with access to that database only.

empty.title: Create your first database
empty.body: WordPress and most PHP apps use MariaDB; many modern apps use PostgreSQL. ekPanel installs the engine on the server the first time.

databases.none_on_server: No databases on this server yet.

engine_hint.mariadb: Compatible with MySQL. WordPress, Laravel, most PHP apps.
engine_hint.postgresql: Advanced SQL. Django, Rails, many Node and Go apps.

databases.name: Database name
databases.name_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and _ , up to 32 characters.
databases.password_note: ekPanel creates a strong password and shows it once. Only a one-way hash is stored.
databases.password_once: Copy the password now. ekPanel does not keep it and cannot show it again; you can only reset it.
databases.connect_hint: Use these details in your application's settings on the same server. Remote access is off.
databases.reset_hint: The current password stops working as soon as the server applies the new one.
databases.applying: Applying on the server. The first database on a server also installs the engine, which takes a minute or two.
databases.error_title: The server could not apply this database

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.body: Removes the database, all its data and its user from the server.
delete.warning: All tables and data in this database are deleted permanently. Applications using it stop working.

files.title: Files
files.trash_hint: Deleted files wait here. Restore puts an item back into public_html; deleting from the trash is permanent.
files.name: Name
files.empty: This folder is empty. Drop files here to upload them.
files.drop_hint: Tip: drag files from your computer onto the list to upload them.
files.exists: A file with this name already exists.
files.unsaved: You have unsaved changes. Close without saving?
files.binary: This file is not text, so it cannot be edited here. Download it instead.
files.chmod_hint: Three digits: owner, group, others. 644 for files and 755 for folders suit most sites.

sftp.title: SFTP access
sftp.intro: Use FileZilla, WinSCP or any SFTP app to manage this site's files. The account only sees this site's folder and cannot run commands.
sftp.password_once: Copy this password now. It is shown only once and ekPanel does not keep it.
sftp.keys_hint: Sign in without a password: paste public keys (id_ed25519.pub), one per line.

wordpress.title: Install WordPress
wordpress.intro: A fresh WordPress with its own MariaDB database, ready in about a minute. ekPanel creates the database, downloads WordPress, writes wp-config.php and sets up your admin account.
wordpress.installing: Installing WordPress. This takes about a minute; you can leave this page.
wordpress.failed: The last install did not finish: {{reason}}
wordpress.empty_note: The website folder must be empty (the ekPanel welcome page is fine), so none of your files are overwritten.
wordpress.password_once: Your WordPress admin password is shown only once. Copy it now; ekPanel does not keep it.
wordpress.installed_hint: Plugins and updates work directly from WordPress; no FTP details are needed.
wordpress.with_site_hint: Creates a database and installs WordPress as soon as the site is ready.

backups.intro: Encrypted, deduplicated backups of your websites and databases, kept on the server or in S3-compatible storage.

empty.title: No backups yet
empty.body: Add a backup location and ekPanel backs up every website and database on that server on a schedule.

kind_hint.local: Fast to set up, but lost if the server's disk is lost.
kind_hint.s3: Amazon S3, Backblaze B2, Cloudflare R2, Wasabi, MinIO and others. Safer: kept off the server.

backups.name: Name

s3.endpoint_hint: The host name only, for example s3.us-west-002.backblazeb2.com
s3.secret_note: The keys are stored only on the server, readable by root. The panel does not keep them.

backups.keep_hint: Older backups are removed after each run. Because backups are deduplicated, keeping many costs little extra space.
backups.connect_existing: Connect backups made earlier, using their recovery key
backups.recovery_once: This is the recovery key. It is shown only this once. Without it, nobody (including you) can read these backups.
backups.recovery_hint: Keep it somewhere safe and away from this server, such as a password manager. You need it to restore after rebuilding the server.
backups.no_snapshots: No backups here yet. Click “Back up now” to make the first one.

mode_hint.folder: Puts the files in a “restored-…” folder in the site's home, next to public_html. Nothing current changes.
mode_hint.replace: Swaps public_html for the backup. The current files move to the site's trash, so you can still get them back.

backups.db_restore_warning: This replaces everything in the database with the backup. Changes made since then are lost.
backups.remove_body: Stops backing up here. The backups themselves are not deleted; you can connect them again with the recovery key.
backups.remove_confirm: ekPanel stops backing up here and forgets the location. The stored backups stay where they are and can be connected again with the recovery key.
backups.saved_it: I have saved the recovery key
backups.remove_body_local: Stops backing up here. The backups already made stay on the server in {{path}}; delete that folder yourself if you no longer need them.
backups.remove_confirm_local: ekPanel stops backing up here and forgets the location. The backups stay in {{path}} on the server, and cannot be connected again from the panel.

firewall.title: Firewall
firewall.unmanaged: ekPanel is not managing this server's firewall, so whatever firewall the server has stays as it is. Turn it on to block every incoming connection except SSH, websites, the ekPanel agent and the ports you open.
firewall.off: The firewall is off: every port that a program listens on can be reached. Your rules are kept for when you turn it on again.
firewall.always_open: Always open: SSH ({{ssh}}), HTTP (80), HTTPS (443) and the ekPanel agent (7443). Everything else coming in is blocked unless a rule below opens it.
firewall.confirm_on: Incoming connections are blocked except SSH ({{ssh}}), HTTP, HTTPS and the ekPanel agent. Anything else that is reached from outside (a mail server, a game server, a database used by other machines) stops working until you open its port.
firewall.confirm_off: Every port that a program listens on becomes reachable from the internet.

apps.intro: Run any Docker image or Compose file. Ports stay private to the server; a domain with free HTTPS points at the app.

empty.title: Run your first app
empty.body: Install a ready-made service from the catalogue, run any Docker image, or paste a Compose file. ekPanel installs Docker on first use.

kind_hint.image: One container from an image, with variables and kept folders.
kind_hint.compose: Several services described in a docker-compose.yml.
kind_hint.git: Built from a branch with its Dockerfile, released without downtime.

apps.name: Name
apps.name_hint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Used for the folder and containers.
apps.image_hint: From Docker Hub or any registry, for example nginx:alpine or ghcr.io/owner/app:1.2
apps.compose_hint: Ports are kept private: publish them on 127.0.0.1, or use the port setting below for the domain.
apps.service_hint: The service in the Compose file that listens on the port.
apps.port_hint: The port the app listens on. Leave empty if it serves nothing over HTTP.
apps.domain_hint: Optional. Point its DNS at the server; HTTPS is set up for it.
apps.env_hint_image: One NAME=value per line, like a .env file. Lines starting with # are skipped.
apps.env_hint_compose: One NAME=value per line. The Compose file reads them as ${NAME}.
apps.volumes_hint: Paths inside the container, one per line. Their contents survive updates and restarts.
apps.public_ports: Allow ports published on public addresses
apps.public_ports_hint: Docker opens such ports past the firewall. Turn this on only for services that must be reached directly, such as a mail or game server.
apps.first_run: The first app on a server installs Docker, which takes a minute or two. Images download on the server.
apps.not_ready: Setting up the app on the server…
apps.no_containers: No containers. If the app is stopped, start it.

delete.title: Delete this app
delete.body: Stops and removes its containers. You choose whether its data goes too.
delete.keeps: The containers are removed. By default the data (volumes and the app folder) stays on the server, and an app created later with the same name uses it again.
delete.with_data_hint: Removes the volumes and /srv/ekpanel/apps/{{name}}. This cannot be undone.

catalog.title: App catalogue
catalog.intro: Ready-made services, reviewed by ekPanel. Passwords and keys are made fresh for every install.
catalog.browse: install a ready-made service from the catalogue
catalog.none_body: Try another word, or run any image with Add app.
catalog.no_servers: Add a server first; services are installed on one of your servers.
catalog.domain_hint: The service is used through this domain. Point its DNS at the server first; HTTPS is set up for it.
catalog.secrets_note: Passwords and keys are generated now and kept in the app's variables. The app's page shows what you need to sign in.
catalog.what_runs: What will run, and a memory limit
catalog.memory_hint: Optional, for the main service. It needs about {{size}} MB.
catalog.sign_in_hint: These are the app's variables. Changing a password in the app itself does not change them here.
catalog.compose_fixed: The Compose file and port come from the catalogue. You can change the domain, variables and limits.

uptime-kuma.description: Watch websites, servers and services, and get alerts when they go down.
uptime-kuma.notes: Open the app right after installing: the first visitor creates the administrator account.

grafana.description: Dashboards and charts for metrics and logs from many data sources.
grafana.notes: Sign in with the user name and password below.

n8n.description: Automate work by connecting apps and APIs in a visual workflow editor.
n8n.notes: Open the app right after installing to create the owner account. Keep N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY: credentials saved in n8n cannot be read without it.

gitea.description: Light Git hosting with pull requests, issues, wikis and a package registry.
gitea.notes: Open the app right after installing and finish the setup page, where you create the administrator account. Git works over HTTPS.

it-tools.description: Handy tools for developers in one place: converters, generators, formatters and more.

vaultwarden.description: A light password manager that works with the Bitwarden apps and browser extensions.
vaultwarden.notes: Create your account, then set SIGNUPS_ALLOWED to false in the variables so nobody else can sign up. The admin page at /admin asks for the token below.

umami.description: Simple website analytics that respects privacy and needs no cookies.
umami.notes: Sign in as admin with the password umami, and change it right away.

ghost.description: A publishing platform for blogs, newsletters and paid memberships.
ghost.notes: The first start takes a minute or two while the database is set up. Then open /ghost on the domain to create the owner account. Newsletters need a mail service, set up in Ghost.

listmonk.description: Newsletters and mailing lists, with templates, fast sending and reports.
listmonk.notes: Sign in with the user name and password below. Add your SMTP server in Settings → SMTP to send mail.

nextcloud.description: Your own cloud for files, calendars and contacts, with apps for every device.
nextcloud.notes: Sign in with the user name and password below. The first start takes a few minutes while Nextcloud sets itself up.

memos.description: Quick notes and a personal timeline, written in Markdown.
memos.notes: Open the app right after installing: the first account becomes the administrator.

excalidraw.description: A whiteboard for sketching diagrams that look hand-drawn.
excalidraw.notes: Drawings stay in the browser. Use Export to save them as files.

ntfy.description: Send push notifications to your phone or computer from scripts and apps.
ntfy.notes: Nobody can use it until you add a user: open the app's shell and run ntfy user add --role=admin yourname

redis.description: A fast in-memory store for caches, sessions and queues, for websites and apps on this server.
redis.notes: Connect to 127.0.0.1:{{port}} with the password below. It cannot be reached from other servers.

deploys.title: Deployments
deploys.repo_hint: Its https:// address, or for a private repository its SSH address (git@github.com:owner/app.git) with the deploy key the app page shows.
deploys.context_hint: The folder Docker builds from; . is the whole repository.
deploys.port_hint: The port the app listens on inside its container. Needed to release without downtime.
deploys.env_hint: One NAME=value per line. The Dockerfile can also read them while building, with ARG NAME.
deploys.auto_hint: When the repository's webhook reports a push to the branch, build and release it.
deploys.webhook_hint: In the repository's settings, add a webhook with this address and secret, for push events, sending JSON. Works with GitHub, GitLab, Gitea and Forgejo.
deploys.deploy_key_hint: Add this key to the repository as a read-only deploy key, so the server can clone it over SSH.
deploys.deploy_key_https: Needed only for private repositories: switch the address to SSH and add this key to the repository as a read-only deploy key.
deploys.none: Nothing deployed yet. Deploy builds the branch with its Dockerfile and starts it.
deploys.waiting: Waiting for the build to start…

builder_hint.auto: The Dockerfile if the repository has one, otherwise Railpack.
builder_hint.railpack: Detects the language and framework; no Dockerfile needed.

previews.enable_hint: A pull request to the branch gets an app of its own, rebuilt on every push and removed when the request closes. Pull requests from forks are not previewed. At most 5 at a time.
previews.domain_hint: Point *.{{domain}} at the server; a preview of pull request 12 is at <app>-pr12.{{domain}}.
previews.title: Previews
previews.intro: Pull requests to this app's branch, each at its own address under {{domain}}.
previews.none: No open pull requests. Open one in the repository to see its preview here.
previews.goes_away: It is removed when the pull request closes.

customers.intro: People who host with you. Each customer sees only their own websites, databases and apps, within the limits of their package.

empty.title: No customers yet
empty.body: Create a package first, then add customers. They sign in to this panel with their own account.

customers.needs_package: Create a package before adding customers.
customers.password_generated: A password is generated and shown once. You can reset it later.
customers.password_once: The customer's password, shown only this once. Send it to them over a safe channel.
customers.share_hint: They can change it under Security after signing in.
customers.delete_body: The account is removed. A customer who still owns something cannot be deleted.
customers.delete_has: They still have {{sites}} websites, {{databases}} databases and {{apps}} apps. Delete or move them first.
customers.acting_as: You are signed in as {{name}} ({{email}}). Everything you do is recorded under your own name.

packages.intro: What each customer may use: how many websites, databases and apps, disk space, and memory and CPU for all their processes together.

empty.title: No packages yet
empty.body: A package sets a customer's limits. Make one, such as "Starter" or "Business", then add customers to it.

packages.name: Name
packages.counts_hint: How many of each a customer may have. 0 for apps means no Docker apps.
packages.limits_hint: Memory and CPU cover all of a customer's PHP and app processes together. Empty means no limit.
packages.servers_hint: Where the customer may create things. None ticked means every server.
packages.images_hint: One per line: a name such as nginx (any tag), or a prefix ending in / such as ghcr.io/acme/. Empty means any image. Customers cannot use Compose files.
packages.git_apps_hint: Customers can build and deploy their own repositories. Builds run on the server, within the package's memory and CPU.

cron.title: Cron jobs
cron.none: No scheduled jobs. Add one to run a command on a schedule, such as a backup script or a Laravel scheduler.
cron.command_hint_site: Runs with sh as the website's own account, starting in public_html. Output is kept in the job's log.
cron.command_hint_app: Runs with sh inside the app's container.
cron.expression_hint: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week, for example 30 2 * * 1-5
cron.name: Name (optional)
cron.service_hint: The app's service to run in. Image apps have one, app.

traffic.title: Traffic
traffic.none: No requests in this time range yet.
traffic.delay: Counted from the web server's log every 15 minutes.

weblogs.title: Logs
weblogs.php_empty: No PHP errors logged. Errors from your code show up here.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: Nothing yet. Alerts about your servers, websites and backups appear here.
notifications.intro: Choose where alerts go: email, Telegram, Discord, Slack or a webhook. They always appear under the bell too.
notifications.no_channels: No channels yet. Alerts still appear under the bell.
notifications.name: Name
notifications.chat_id_hint: Your chat's number (ask @userinfobot) or a channel's @name. Send /start to the bot first.

url_hint.discord: Server settings → Integrations → Webhooks → Copy URL.
url_hint.slack: An Incoming Webhook URL from your Slack app.
url_hint.webhook: ekPanel sends a signed JSON POST to this address.

notifications.keep_secret: Leave empty to keep the saved one.
notifications.key_once: The signing key, shown only this once. Check the X-Ekpanel-Signature header (HMAC-SHA256 of the body) with it.
notifications.key_hint: Keep it in the service that receives the webhook.

mail.title: Mail server and panel address
mail.body: Email notifications go out through this SMTP server. The panel address makes the links in messages work.
mail.panel_url_hint: How people open this panel, such as https://panel.example.com

terminal.confirm_body: A terminal can change anything on the server. Confirm it is you; this lasts 15 minutes.
terminal.note: Opening and closing are recorded in the audit log. The shell closes after 30 minutes without typing.
